---
title: "Quality Policy"
---

```{r}
#| label: quality-policy-content
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

helper_candidates <- c(
	file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "_data_helpers.R"),
	file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "Course File Resources", "_data_helpers.R")
)
source(helper_candidates[file.exists(helper_candidates)][1])

policy_df <- read_workbook_sheet(cf_sheet("quality_policy"), col_names = FALSE)

if (is.null(policy_df)) {
	notify_workbook_missing()
} else {
	policy_text <- trimws(as.character(policy_df[[1]][2]))
	cat(policy_text, "\n")
}
```
